data_set_description.name: Titanic
data_set_description.description:
**Author**: Frank E. Harrell Jr., Thomas Cason  
**Source**: [Vanderbilt Biostatistics](http://biostat.mc.vanderbilt.edu/wiki/pub/Main/DataSets/titanic.html)  
**Please cite**:   

The original Titanic dataset, describing the survival status of individual passengers on the Titanic. The titanic data does not contain information from the crew, but it does contain actual ages of half of the passenger
